Order
The instant writ petition has been filed with a prayer for mandamus to permit the petitioner to participate in the transfer counselling to be conducted in pursuant to the proceedings in R.No.4910/2022/S12/FSD dated 12.05.2025 by the 2nd respondent.

2. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner would submit that though the petitioner had filed the writ petition for seeking mandamus, to permit the petitioner to participate in the transfer counselling dated 12.05.2025, now that, the counseling had already been conducted,
therefore, restrict his prayer to direct the respondents to consider his representation for transfer to Vellore.
3.

At this juncture, the learned Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondents would submit that by virtue of G.O.(D).No.4, Health and Family Welfare (M1) Department, dated 07.01.2025, the petitioner become ineligible to participate in the counseling and would further submit https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 23/07/2025 03:55:28 pm ) that, if any representation is received from the petitioner, the same will be considered by them in accordance to its own merits and in accordance with law within a reasonable time.

4. Heard the submissions of the learned counsel on either side and also perused the materials available on record.
5.

In view of the above submission made by the learned Government Advocate, the petitioner is directed to give a fresh representation to the respondents within a period of one (1) week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and on such receipt the representation, the respondents are directed to consider the same and pass order according to its own merits and in accordance with law, within a period of two (2) weeks, thereafter.
6. With the above observations, the writ petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petitions stand closed.
